origin.description: Newton steady state with a banded Jacobian. The default half-bandwidth is nspec.
origin.usage: steady.band(y, time = 0, func, parms = NULL, nspec = NULL, bandup = nspec, banddown = nspec, ...)

arguments.name: y
arguments.text: Initial state. Names are kept when y is a dict.

arguments.name: func
arguments.text: func(time, state, parms) returns a list whose first element is the derivatives.

arguments.name: parms
arguments.text: Passed through to func. NULL when the model has no parameters.

arguments.name: nspec
arguments.text: Species per box. The default band is nspec on each side.

origin.example: steady.band(y = c(1, 2, 3, 4), func = function(t, y, p) list(-0.1 * y), nspec = 1)

translation.description: Newton steady state with a banded Jacobian. The default half-bandwidth is nspec.
translation.usage: steady_band(y, times=0, func=None, parms=None, nspec=None, bandup=None, banddown=None, **kwargs)

arguments.name: y
arguments.text: Initial state. Names are kept when y is a dict.

arguments.name: func
arguments.text: func(time, state, parms) returns a list whose first element is the derivatives.

arguments.name: parms
arguments.text: Passed through to func. NULL when the model has no parameters.

arguments.name: nspec
arguments.text: Species per box. The default band is nspec on each side.

translation.example:
from rootSolve import steady_band

def decay(t, y, p):
    return [[-0.1 * value for value in y]]

print(steady_band([1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0], func=decay, nspec=1))
